name: Touma Misuzu
source:
Hobbies: Wasting
Skills: Wasting

The daughter of a noble family which has been a noble family ever since the Kamakura period (years 1185 to 1333) and is still running strong. Because of the fact that Misuzu's extremely wealthy, she loves to waste money. For example, she likes making hand fans out of 10,000 yen bills or even bathing in them. Due to this, she is seen quite as an oddball, and Misuzu herself has a tsundere personality as well. She considers Tamaki as her greatest rival.

Though she doesn't want to admit it herself, Misuzu has some hidden masochistic tendencies and trembles in pleasure when she says "I do not want to feel like a commoner!". In fact, she is just a plain old masochist who pretends to be sadistic, bossy tsundere lady.
